summary: Iteration 7: Auto Mode, Mode 4 No-Win, Bonus send-to-all, login page, game regression. Backend pytest 7/7 passed (test_iter7_auto_nowin_bonus.py): config validation (auto counts >100, <0 and both 0 return 400; 'bogus' mode returns 400; 'nowin' accepted). Auto Mode ON with 1/1 sets auto_pos=0, and the next rounds #1406/#1407/#1408 were random/minority/random with auto=true. While Auto was ON, public-state, state config.mode and round.mode were null, and /game/fair returned active=false with upcoming=[]. No-Win: ODD-only bet in round #1409 gave EVEN and the bet was lost (balance -1000). Bets on both sides in round #1410 gave all_lose=true, total_payout 0, and both wallets were debited exactly. Bonus all_users sent 44 of 44. Frontend: admin Game Configuration auto-mode-panel and toggle work on 1920x800 and 390x844 (no horizontal overflow; status shows 'ON · Round #1412: Standard 1/3 · Next: Standard' and switches back to OFF). config-mode-select includes 'Mode 4 · No-Win'. Bonus tab: the all-users checkbox hides the username and random inputs, the confirm dialog says 'Send ₹1 to ALL active users?', and the toast says 'Bonus sent to 44 of 44 user(s)'. /login at 390x844 fits one screen (scrollHeight 844) and the dice fades into black. The game page as player1 at 390x844: ODD selection, the ₹10 preset and place bet all work (balance 1353 -> 1343, toast shown, my-round-bets updated). The guest game page renders. No page errors.

minor.issue: all_lose is not exposed to players and the frontend never references it. In a No-Win round with bets on both sides, the reveal shows e.g. EVEN while EVEN bettors lose. This matches the spec ('displayed dice random') but may confuse players.
The round in progress when Auto is turned ON keeps the old dropdown mode with auto=false, so its round.mode is still visible to players in public_round until the next round.

issues: Right after toggling ON, the status says 'Round #1412: Standard 1/3', but #1412 was created before the toggle and is not an auto round. Consider 'Starts next round: Standard 1/3'.
The User column shows short user IDs (e.g. a9955420) instead of usernames.

action_items: Optional: surface all_lose in public_round and show a 'No winners this round' message on the reveal
Optional: label the auto status as 'next round' when the current round is not an auto round
Optional: show the username in the bonus history table
critical_code_review_comments: pytest.ini enables xdist (-n). Tests that change the shared game config race with each other, so run them with -n 0.

risk_gate runs on cfg['mode'] before the auto override. If the dropdown is 'risk' while Auto is ON, the risk pause logic still applies even though rounds run random or minority. place_bet does the same for the exposure check.
seed_data_creation: Placed 10-rupee bets: player1 in rounds #1409, #1410 and #1414 (UI), friend1 in #1410. Admin bonuses: 'Test all' ₹1 to all 44 active users twice (the suite ran twice because the -k filter was ignored) and 'Test all UI' ₹1 once. The config was changed temporarily and restored to mode=random, auto_mode=false, auto_standard=3, auto_minority=6, paused=false (verified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run test_iter7_auto_nowin_bonus.py with '-n 0'. It takes about 3.5 minutes, sends a ₹1 bonus to all users and restores the config in fixture teardown. Admin testids: auto-mode-panel, auto-mode-toggle, auto-standard-input, auto-minority-input, auto-mode-status, config-mode-select, admin-tab-bonus, bonus-send-all-users, bonus-send-amount, bonus-send-title, bonus-send-button (uses window.confirm).
